name: North Shore Mahjong
description: American Mahjong for the northern Chicago suburbs: open play, Mahjong 101 and advanced strategy classes and leagues for players who know the basics of American Mahjong. Sessions rotate between cafes, taverns and shops in Highland Park, Glenview and nearby towns, plus a clubhouse in Park Ridge.
schedule: Open play, classes and leagues at venues across the North Shore (dates listed on the club site)
